title: Prismatic relief
description: Raised ultramarine facets catch a moving light, revealing sharp ridges and shifting glints.
useCase: Art-direct an abstract material study or sculptural brand texture.
interaction: Rotate the light or pause its orbit
reducedMotion: Automatic light orbit stops. The light-angle control still redraws immediately.
limitations: Analytically projected height-field relief, not paper deformation or a full 3D mesh. Native WebGL1 with no 3D dependency; static fallback after context loss until remount.
look: Near-black field with a rectangular six-by-four panel of cobalt pyramids with off-centre peaks, shaded deep navy to pale sky-blue highlights.
motion: A point light orbits the faceted panel about every 52 seconds, sweeping diffuse shading and specular glints across each pyramid face; the light slider offsets its angle.
adapt: Facet geometry is `cellHit` (6×4 cells with hashed `peak` and height `h`) and lighting is in `main` of `FRAGMENT`; tune `angle` (orbit speed `u_time*.12`), `cobalt`, `bg` and the `spec` exponent. Keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
